verdict.rationale: The security page commits that the company never uses customer data to train its own models and does not let its providers use it for model training. That no-training default covers the story with no opt-out needed, and private-job content is also stated to be off-limits to personnel. missing for 10: contractual backing (e.g. DPA or terms-of-service language) for the no-training commitment, independent or hands-on corroboration of the policy.
